title: Amelia | Everyday comfort dress that just works
bodyHtml:
This is the dress you'll reach for again and again—effortless comfort that doesn't compromise on looking put-together. Designed for those days when you want something that feels good from the moment you slip it on, with a relaxed silhouette that skims your shape without clinging. Soft and breathable fabric moves with you, and practical pockets mean your hands are finally free. It's the kind of dress you wear for a quick errand and end up keeping on all day because it's simply perfect.

Why you'll love it

  • Soft, breathable fabric that keeps you comfortable all day long
  • Relaxed silhouette that flatters without the fuss
  • Practical pockets—because where else would you put your phone?
  • Works equally well dressed up for a café lunch or down for the school run
  • Resists creasing, so it looks fresh from morning to evening
  • The dress you don't have to think about—it just works
  • Versatile enough for warm days and layered on cooler evenings

Over 50,000 women have already chosen us, with an average rating of 4.8 out of 5. Your happiness and your trust mean everything to us.
